models_evaluated: machine learning model for predicting onward social care needs at admission

links.outcome: ML prediction of discharge care needs compared against clinician predictions and a hybrid model
links.effect: ML performance comparable to clinician predictions despite using a subset of information; each performs better for different care need types; hybrid clinician+ML model more accurate.
links.quote: The model performance is comparable to clinician’s predictions of discharge care needs, despite working with only a subset of the information available to the clinician.

unlisted_practices: Combining clinician and machine predictions in a hybrid human-in-the-loop model to improve early prediction accuracy
Using ML for automated initial discharge need assessment when clinical assessment is delayed

screen.reason: Evaluates combining clinician judgment with machine learning predictions (human-in-the-loop hybrid model) versus either alone for identifying onward social care needs to reduce discharge delays.
